channel.title: Celestine — Art, Music & Film News
channel.description: What's happening right now across art, music, and film.

item.title: Kim Ji Won Sets Out To Save A Child Patient In “Doctor X”
item.description: Actor Kim Ji Won stars as a genius surgeon tasked with saving a young patient in the upcoming medical noir drama "Doctor X."

item.title: Sanjay Gupta, Indian Director of ‘Kaante’ and ‘Zinda,’ Dies at 59
item.description: Indian filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, known for directing crime thrillers like "Kaante" and "Shootout at Wadala," has died at 59 following a fall at his Mumbai home.

item.title: To Live Is to Believe
item.description: The latest arts roundup features tributes to Ursula von Rydingsvard, an Epstein survivor's message to MoMA, artist interviews, and highlights from a creative Halloween party.

item.title: Timothy Boomer Captures the Uncanny World of Insect Galls
item.description: Photographer Timothy Boomer has captured the bizarre and intricate world of insect galls created by wasps.

item.title: Drukqs (25th Anniversary Edition)
item.description: Richard D. James's once-divisive 2001 electronic album *Drukqs* is being reissued for its 25th anniversary, recognized now as the definitive keystone of his career.

item.title: “Blue dot fever”: Lily Allen dresses up as Ticketmaster unsold seat map for Halloween
item.description: Lily Allen dressed as a Ticketmaster unsold seat map for Halloween to mock the ticketing controversies of her recent North American tour.

item.title: Watch the ‘Rehearsals for a Revolution’ Director and Editor Explain How Memories Can Help Fight Authoritarianism
item.description: Director Pegah Ahangurani and editor Arash Ashtiani discussed how their acclaimed film *Rehearsals for a Revolution* demonstrates using memory to fight authoritarianism.

item.title: Marilyn Monroe and Arthur Miller’s Tragic Love Story
item.description: Hollywood icon Marilyn Monroe and playwright Arthur Miller married in 1956 in a union that quickly deteriorated due to career pressures, personal misunderstandings, and conflicting family desires.

item.title: Need Halloween Inspo? Look No Further Than These IRL Street Style Pics
item.description: Real-life street style looks offer practical wardrobe inspiration for putting together a last-minute Halloween costume straight from your closet.

item.title: Lil Baby Interview: The Atlanta Rapper Takes On New Challenges
item.description: Atlanta rapper Lil Baby has returned with a new hit and expanded sound while maintaining his drive to dominate hip-hop.

item.title: Lee Joon Gi’s Conscience Is Put To The Test By A Murder Mission In “kiDnap GAME”
item.description: New stills from the pan-Asian thriller series "kiDnap GAME" show Lee Joon Gi facing a deadly murder mission.

item.title: Ecuadorian Queer Drama ‘Princess’ Swooped On by MMM Film Sales Ahead of Tallinn
item.description: Paris-based MMM Film Sales has acquired international rights to Christian Rojas’s Ecuadorian queer debut feature, "Princess," ahead of its world premiere at the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival.

item.title: From Paris, In Solidarity
item.description: Kid Cudi will star in a Jean-Michel Basquiat biopic as the arts community navigates widespread protests during Paris art week.

item.title: ‘Street Photography Africa’ is a Colorful and Energetic Survey Across the Continent
item.description: The new article ‘Street Photography Africa’ explores the vibrant and energetic street cultures found across the continent.

item.title: cantu of the sower EP
item.description: Twenty-year-old producer Cantu of the sower has released a genre-defying album-length EP that uses free-jazz logic and digital overload to explore new emotional territory.

item.title: Elon Musk’s AI ‘The Odyssey’ remake dismissed as “garbage”
item.description: Viewers universally panned the first seven minutes of Elon Musk’s AI-generated remake of *The Odyssey* as garbage.

item.title: ‘Queen at Sea’ Review: Juliette Binoche Guides Director Lance Hammer Back to Screens with a Searing Film About Dementia and Consent
item.description: Juliette Binoche and Tom Courtenay star in Lance Hammer's new drama, "Queen at Sea," exploring the heavy toll of dementia and caretaking.

item.title: Queen Camilla Sparkles in an Heirloom Tiara and Show-Stopping Amethysts
item.description: Queen Camilla honored Queen Elizabeth II by wearing the late monarch's heirloom Girls of Britain and Ireland Tiara and matching amethysts at a state banquet.

item.title: The 7 Best Airbnbs for Experiencing Buenos Aires in Peak Pleasant Weather
item.description: A new travel roundup highlights the top Buenos Aires Airbnbs, offering travelers prime locations in historic and modern properties during peak weather.

item.title: “The One About Matthew Perry” Docuseries Comes to Netflix
item.description: Mia Perry Bowick and director Mary Robertson have joined forces for a new Netflix docuseries exploring the life and legacy of the late *Friends* star, Matthew Perry.

item.title: Watch: Hong Seung Hee Vows To Protect Jung Yong Hwa At All Costs In “Oh! My Guard” Teaser
item.description: A new teaser for the upcoming romance drama "Oh! My Guard" highlights Hong Seung Hee's character vowing to protect Jung Yong Hwa's character.

item.title: Aaron Sorkin Thinks About Reviving ‘The West Wing’ for a ‘Couple of Seconds Every Day’: ‘I Miss It’
item.description: Creator Aaron Sorkin revealed he frequently thinks about potentially reviving his acclaimed political drama series "The West Wing."

item.title: NYC Artists Open Their Doors
item.description: New York City artists opened their studios and homes to the public alongside local cultural exhibitions and performances.

item.title: 221 Camera Obscuras Fill Pneuhaus’ Immersive, Inflatable, Image-Capturing Installation
item.description: Pneuhaus has launched "Compound Camera 3," an immersive, inflatable viewing room featuring 221 functional camera obscuras.

item.title: She’s the Best
item.description: The pop star’s fourth album steps off the dancefloor to explore a looser, more liberated sound between the hits and comedowns.

item.title: Paul McCartney on the bugbear from upcoming Beatles biopics that made him text Sam Mendes “don’t do this!”
item.description: Paul McCartney texted director Sam Mendes to warn him about a specific recurring annoyance featured in past Beatles biopics ahead of his upcoming films.

item.title: New ‘Avatar’ Projects Are Everywhere — but the Best One Succeeds by Leaving ‘The Last Airbender’ Behind
item.description: The newest entry in the *Avatar* franchise stands out by finally moving away from its original intellectual property anchor point.

item.title: The Mystery of the Jardine Star Brooch
item.description: Historians have uncovered that a late-Victorian diamond star brooch was likely bequeathed to the late Queen Elizabeth in 1981 by Lady Jardine.

item.title: The Unexpected Joy of a Second Marathon
item.description: An author reflects on the unexpected joy and lighter mental burden of successfully completing a second marathon.

item.title: Ballet Salon Is a New Home for Dancers Who Want to Return to the Stage
item.description: Ballet Salon has been founded as a new performance space for former dancers and students to practice and perform at a high level.
